prompt: Use-case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production PIXEL ART VFX SPRITE SHEET for an enemy-agnostic fantasy JRPG critical hit impact; no characters or enemies, this effect must cover any dynamically injected enemy silhouette. EXACT 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows = EIGHT sequential impact frames, reading order. Each frame is an independent centered 2D explosion effect completely within its own equal cell, ample transparent margins, same scale. Frame1 thin white-blue diagonal slash intersecting tiny amber spark; frame2 very bright dense WHITE SILVER BLUE starburst opaque center with short broad diagonal streaks; frame3 largest bright cream center with crisp pale blue jagged spikes and warm amber small sparks around; frame4 a dense opaque rolling BLUE GREY smoke cloud with a pale hit core and debris; frame5 thick pale blue grey smoke and white shards spreading out, center STILL OCCLUDES enemy body; frame6 wider segmented smoke dissipating with a few amber pixel sparks; frame7 just drifting smoke clumps and small silver debris; frame8 sparse small fading blue grey dust clumps. Visual development: strong hit then brief opaque masking then dissolve, appropriate for both sword impact and arrow impact; no lasers no flames no magic symbols no persistent aura. Crisp 32-bit tactical RPG pixel-art cluster design, restrained muted silver/iceblue/ivory/amber 14-color palette, sharp square stepped shapes, no smooth gradients no antialias no painterly rendering no 3D. Genuine transparent alpha background; no black rectangle, no fog outside frames, no labels, no grid, no people no weapons no terrain no UI. Landscape 3:2 sheet.
